messages.author: 416db20b38a4a961
messages.subject: Choosing hadoop version
parts:
Hello
I am evaluating ways how to use rhipe in production. I run successfully smaller map/reduce jobs in the example ubuntu image and now I am going to create a small cluster for bigger test.
On the first attempt I reused some existing infrastructure but run into problems with java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.Job.setUserClassesTakesPrecedence

As I understand from https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/rhipe/zuhD9ISKoq8 that I am expected to use Cloudera hadoop installations? I am a bit confused, because the virtual image, I have used so far, is rhipe 0.72 + R 2.15.2 + Vanilla Hadoop 1.0.2 and seems to work OK.

Thanks
Ondrej

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Choosing hadoop version
parts:
Yes, i think from 0.74 one instruction was added which is only
compatible with CDH. If i recall correctly, a group of people are
working to make this Apache compliant by removing or working around
that one line.

Regards
Saptarshi
